mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_delivery_material m WHERE m.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND ((m.owner_module=#{query.ownerModule} AND m.entity_type=#{query.entityType} AND m.entity_id=#{query.entityId}) OR (m.source_owner_module=#{query.ownerModule} AND m.source_entity_type=#{query.entityType} AND m.source_entity_id=#{query.entityId})) AND (m.deleted=b'0' OR m.archive_time IS NOT NULL OR (m.archive_status IS NOT NULL AND m.archive_status <> 'NOT_REQUIRED') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_delivery_fulfillment f WHERE f.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND f.material_id=m.id AND f.deleted=b'0') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_delivery_submission s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.deleted=b'0' AND JSON_CONTAINS(s.material_ids_json,CAST(m.id AS JSON))))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_delivery_requirement r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND r.owner_module=#{query.ownerModule} AND r.entity_type=#{query.entityType} AND r.entity_id=#{query.entityId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plt_approval_attempt a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND a.owner_module=#{query.ownerModule} AND a.entity_type=#{query.entityType} AND a.entity_id=#{query.entityId})
